Question 5
?

Which integral gives the area of the finite region bounded by y=x+6 and y=x24−2, shown above?

(Note: Figure not drawn to scale)

a
∫−48(x24−x−8)dx
b
∫−24(x2+x+8)dx
c
∫−48(x24−2)dx
d
∫−48(−x24+x+8)dx
e
∫−24(x+6)dx
